John Bartlett (1820–1905).  Familiar Quotations, 10th ed.  1919.

Washington Irving 1783-1859 John Bartlett

 

1
    Free-livers on a small scale, who are prodigal within the compass of a guinea.

          
The Stout Gentleman.

2
    The almighty dollar,
 
1
 that great object of universal devotion throughout our land, seems to have no genuine devotees in these peculiar villages.

          
The Creole Village.

 
Note 1.
See Jonson,
